entries.scope: Create the seven dated GSDB baseline assessment outputs and reader navigation.
entries.rationale: The accepted feature requires repository-local, bilingual assessment evidence without runtime or platform changes.
audiences: First-year apprentices in all four binding IT occupations
entries.navigationImpact: The dated README links all six non-self outputs and the validation bundle; the feature specification remains the scope source.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in the same reader-facing Markdown artefact; controlled JSON field names remain English.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: macOS repository checks are recorded; unavailable Linux, Windows/WSL2, Podman runtime, network, and provider observations remain Open with triggers.
entries.risk: Incorrect navigation, stale evidence, or a missing language partner could cause an unsupported security conclusion; validators and manual review reduce this risk.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate when the GSDB manifest, checklist versions, inventory, preset profile, documentation validator, or assessment scope changes.
